name: Hire an ERC-8004 agent on BSC by provable execution
description: Pick the agent in a strategy category (grid, yield, health-factor, rebalancing) with the best on-chain track record, and return its most recent settled fill with the transaction that proves it. Uses the Agripinaa Agent Index: listing with per-field provenance, the public proof feed, and Ophis settlement receipts.

category.description: Which kind of agent to hire.

prompt_template:
You are choosing an AI agent to hire on BNB Smart Chain for the user. Inputs: {{inputs}}

Do this in order and do not skip a step:
1. Call listAgents with the requested category and limit 50. Prefer agents whose trust.isVerified is true, then the highest trust.totalScore. Keep the page's `source` field: it says which index lane answered (the-graph, 8004scan, snapshot) and you must report it as provenance.
2. Call getProofFeed. Events whose `agent` equals a listed agent's `tokenId` are that agent's actions. Take the newest event of kind trade, rotate, repair, mint or rebalance for your chosen agent.
3. If that event has an `orderUid`, call getReceipt with it and report the settlement transaction and surplus from the receipt. If it only has a `txHash`, report that.
4. Answer with: the agent (tokenId, name, profile URL https://agripinaa.vercel.app/agent/56/<tokenId>), the index source, the latest fill (summary, time, orderUid, settlement tx), and the activation URL https://agripinaa.vercel.app/agent/56/<tokenId>/activate. Never invent a transaction hash; if no proof event exists for the agent say so and pick the next one.
